title: SWF: Test SWF file header and version byte
description: Verify that compiled SWF files have correct header: signature FWS/CWS, version byte = 8 for Flash 8 SWFs, correct file length field. Tests: compile a minimal doc, parse the 8-byte header, verify signature, version=8, fileLength matches actual byte count. Also verify the RECT (frame size) field encodes width/height correctly as TWIPS (×20).
